infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Maximo Companion uses your location during active work trips to accurately record technician route waypoints and trip distances.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Maximo Companion requires continuous location access during active trips to sync route milestones with Maximo even while your phone is locked or in your pocket.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Maximo Companion requires background location access during active trips to log travel routes without interrupting your work.
